ratings.comment: This guy was a really interesting teacher. He got college kids and made English more fun. Taught critical thinking skills that will help in any class.

this guy is so full of BS it's incredible, but entertaining. He just spews negativity all class on topics that have nothin to do with engineering. He admits to it and said "that's how the world works." It's hard to sit through, but the class is really easy.

One of the best instructors I've had.  Is truly a know it all - in a very positive way.  He's an endless source of information on any topic.  Also a nice guy, and really does a great job of preparing engineers to be porfessionals which they otherwise have difficulty with.  Out of maybe 50 professors I've ever had, he's top 5 for sure.

I was not looking forward to taking this class, but I'm glad I did, and I'm glad I had this prof.  All of the assignments were very useful and meaningful.  The lectures were pretty entertaining too.  The only thing I didn't like was all the group work, but I understand why it was necessary.
